caption: The drawing depicts a large bird of prey, specifically an eagle, rendered in a realistic style. The eagle is shown in a side view with its left wing extended upward and its beak open, revealing a pink tongue. The bird's feathers are primarily brown, with shades varying from dark to light brown on the upper parts, and some white or cream-colored feathers visible on the underside and edges of the body and wings. The eye is round and yellow with a dark pupil. The hooked beak is black at the tip, transitioning to a lighter, more yellowish color near the face. The eagle's talons are yellow, with dark claws. The background is a plain, light beige or off-white color, and there are no other objects or elements present in the drawing.
title: Carved Wooden Eagle
